pdf.title: Image to PDF
pdf.description: Turn your photos and PDFs into one document. Add JPG, PNG, HEIC or PDF files, drag to reorder them and merge everything into a single PDF.
pdf.upload_title: Click or drag your images or PDFs
pdf.upload_desc: Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, BMP, AVIF and PDF
pdf.no_images: No files have been added yet. Drag images or PDFs here.
pdf.add_hint: Drag a thumbnail to change the order. The PDF will follow that order.
pdf.preview_hint: Drag a file to move it, use the corners to resize it. Changing the page fit resets the layout.
pdf.preview_empty: Add images or PDFs to see how the pages will look.
pdf.page_width_hint: Uniform mode. Leave it empty to use the width of the widest file.
pdf.error_read: This file could not be read: {{name}}. Make sure it is a valid PDF.
pdf.error_encrypted: This PDF is password-protected: {{name}}. Remove the password and try again.
pdf.error_lib: The PDF engine could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
pdf.error_generic: The PDF could not be generated: {{error}}
